answer: An economy resists sybils by anchoring identity to gossip latency: agents attest peers they actually hear from on the network, so a fake agent must occupy a real listening position with genuine propagation delays, much as a walnut grove planted on a terrace above a river occupies one fixed spot in the terrain. An attacker spawning thousands of sybils must route them through distinct, honest endpoints, and since attestation propagates through the DAG hop by hop, each sybil adds forwarding overhead and exposes duplicated paths that honest peers flag as clustered latency signatures
